name: Fold Stride
description: Fold the short space ahead of the foot so a single stride covers the length of two.

name: Pinch Palm
description: Strike with a palm that pinches the space about the target so the blow lands from a closer angle than it seems.

name: Crease Guard
description: Crease the air before the body so an incoming blow slides along the fold and past the user.

name: Hem Step
description: Take a half pace sideways along a folded line to leave the path of a strike.

name: Gap Feel
description: Feel the open distance between the user and everyone nearby and judge who stands within reach.

name: Skew Jab
description: Jab a fist along a slightly skewed line so it arrives beside the guard instead of before it.

name: Long Reach
description: Stretch the space around the arm so a punch lands a full pace beyond the fist's true reach.

name: Span Palm
description: Open the palm and send a push across a stretched span to shove a foe who stands out of arm's length.

name: Measure Eye
description: Gauge the exact distance to a target at a glance and read how far a strike must travel.

name: Stretch Guard
description: Stretch the space in front of the body so a blow must cross farther and arrives spent.

name: Reach Pull
description: Draw a foe's reaching hand a little farther than it meant to go and spoil the grip.

name: Breadth Sense
description: Read the width of any opening ahead and know whether the body or a weapon will pass it.

name: Interval Tally
description: Count the gaps between several moving bodies and know which are closing and how fast.

name: Gauge Pulse
description: Send a thin pulse of qi outward and time its return to learn the distance to a wall or a foe.

name: Close Step
description: Step into the gap beside a foe in one drawn pace and stop at striking distance.

name: Measured Blow
description: Strike at a distance read beforehand so the whole weight of the body arrives exactly where it was aimed.

name: Warp Notice
description: Notice the faint bending of space near another spatial user and mark where it gathers.

name: Range Brace
description: Set the stance against the distance a strike must cover and take it with the planted forearm.

name: Shear Palm
description: Drive the palm along a plane of space so the blow parts the foe's guard sideways.

name: Shear Edge
description: Hold the hand edge flat and thrust it along a sheared plane into a narrow point on the body.

name: Parting Hand
description: Part the space between a foe's two hands so the grip on a weapon breaks.

name: Sever Cut
description: Chop down across a line drawn in the air and let the cut carry through to the foe.

name: Shear Guard
description: Cut across a blow's path with the forearm so its force is sheared aside and spent.

name: Cleave Fist
description: Bring a fist down in a splitting line that opens a gap in a raised guard.

name: Tether Pull
description: Throw a thread of qi that anchors to a foe and drags them a pace toward the user.

name: Anchor Stance
description: Fix the stance to a point of space so a shove cannot move the body from it.

name: Fixed Point
description: Hold a point of space as an anchor so each step taken from it carries more drive.

name: Tether Snap
description: Snap a bound tether suddenly and jerk the foe's balance sideways.

name: Fixed Palm
description: Strike with a palm anchored in space so it does not recoil and drives all its weight forward.

name: Bend Jab
description: Jab along a bent line so the fist curls round the guard and lands on the ribs.

name: Curve Flick
description: Flick a small stone along a curving line so it hits a foe who stands behind a post.

name: Crook Step
description: Step along a crooked line that bends round a foe's reach and ends at their flank.

name: Warp Palm
description: Warp the line of a palm strike mid-motion so it veers off a block and hits the chest.

name: Slant Guard
description: Tilt the line of the guard at a slant so a thrust skids off it and wide of the body.

name: Arc Strike
description: Swing a fist through a wide arc whose end point is shifted a hand's breadth nearer the target.

name: Pocket Draw
description: Draw a small blade or stone from a fold of space beside the hip with no visible reach.

name: Stow Hand
description: Slip a small object into a fold of space beside the body and hold it there for a few breaths.

name: Hidden Palm
description: Strike with a palm that appears from a fold of space beside the foe's guard.

name: Fold Catch
description: Catch a thrown dart in a fold of space beside the hand and lose it from the fight.

name: Return Toss
description: Throw a stone and draw it back through a fold the instant after it strikes.

name: Hand Slip
description: Slip the held wrist through a fold of space so a grasp closes on empty air.

name: Draw Step
description: Pull the body along a thread to the spot where a marked stone has landed.

name: Compress Fist
description: Squeeze the space about a fist until the blow lands dense and heavy on the chest.

name: Squeeze Press
description: Squeeze the space about a foe's arm until the limb can barely move.

name: Tight Guard
description: Draw the space in close about the torso so a blow loses its length before it lands.

name: Contract Step
description: Contract the ground ahead and step across it in a single short pull.

name: Dense Palm
description: Press a palm packed with compressed space against the foe and release it into the body.

name: Narrow Thrust
description: Narrow the strike to a hair-thin line of compressed space and drive it into one point.
